digest.component_or_area: Jira reconcile bridge outbound comment sync
propositions: The outbound comment sync re-posted duplicate comments to Jira on every hourly pass due to an inert PRIMARY id-identity dedup map (comment_ids empty), causing ~30 issues to accumulate bot-authored duplicates and pinning REB-1861 at Jira's 5000-comment hard cap.

Phase 1 cleanup deleted 29,931 duplicate bot-marked comments from 27 of 30 affected issues, identified by pre-strip marker detection and deduplicated by normalized body, keeping only the oldest copy of each distinct body, with independent verification confirming zero missing distinct bodies and unchanged non-candidate counts.

Phase 2 (836 truncation-suffix comments on REB-1567, REB-1931, REB-2605) was deliberately not executed; these comments lack the marker due to outbound truncation at 32767 chars cutting off the marker paragraph, and require a separate evidence-gated rule behind --include-truncated.

The reconcile-bridge workflow remains paused throughout the operation and was not re-enabled; 29,931-line append-only deletion log, 150MB of pre-deletion backups, and 713+ throttle-after retries confirm safe, resumable execution with zero failed deletions.
REB-1861 was reduced from 5000 to 79 comments by the cleanup; all 30 affected issues are now far below the 5000-comment cap and hold exactly one copy of each distinct normalized body.
